item.title: Elevated early Eocene atmospheric CO<sub>2</sub> tied to reduced Southern Ocean biological pump efficiency
item.content:encoded:
Nature Geoscience, Published online: 06 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41561-026-02142-7

Warming in the early Eocene reduced the efficiency of the Southern Ocean biological carbon pump, limiting carbon sequestration in the ocean interior and enhancing atmospheric CO2 levels, according to foraminifera-bound nitrogen isotope records.
